Notes on quiet corners for a familiar shift
This page is for you
Travel preparation for pets

This guide helps travelers bring an animal with care and confidence. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways supports clear planning, calm check-in, and steady coordination with crews.

Start by reviewing the pet type, carrier, and route details before you arrive. Small changes in space, temperature, or carrier fit can affect the trip, so it helps to prepare early and keep documents easy to reach.

<<FACT F067>> Keep the crate secure, clean, and well ventilated, and make sure the animal can stand and turn naturally. If you are traveling with a cat, bring familiar bedding and limit extra movement through the terminal.

For a large dog, review the handling plan with the desk before departure. <<FACT F075>> Staff can explain where the animal will go, how loading is handled, and what to expect during handoff. A calm routine makes the process easier for you and for the crew.

Health papers should match the animal and the route. <<FACT F084>> Carry the certificate with the rest of your travel documents so it is easy to present when asked. If the papers are not current, contact the desk before you leave home.

If your pet seems unsettled, pause, speak softly, and follow the guidance given by the senior coordinator or the service team. Escalations are reviewed in a calm stepwise way so travelers receive practical support without confusion.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support.
